title: 矽光子生物感測器
summary: 從表面感測、參考通道與檢出限拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate surface sensing, reference channels and detection limits, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設濃度校正斜率 0.20 nm/(mg/L)，空白波長標準差 0.002 nm，以 3σ/slope 估計 LOD=0.030 mg/L。此為自訂統計示例，不是任何生物標記的診斷門檻。
workedExample.textEn: Assume calibration slope 0.20 nm/(mg/L) and blank wavelength SD 0.002 nm. A 3σ/slope estimate gives LOD=0.030 mg/L. This is a statistical teaching example, not a diagnostic cutoff for any biomarker.
workedExample.assumptions: 假設局部線性、穩定空白與指定噪聲統計；吸附飽和、基質效應不在算例內。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Assume local linearity, stable blanks and specified noise statistics; adsorption saturation and matrix effects are excluded.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.
